data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net release of $11.9m in prior year reserves. This includes a $7.4m release due to a refinement in the methodology for estimating claims reserves, and a $4.5m profit from the reinsurance to close of the 2020 year of account. The overall direction of prior year development is a release.
